cell 6: follow-through: the blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, hair trailing back
cell 7: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the sword lifts back toward the ready angle
cell 8: settle: almost the ready pose, sword a touch lower than in the reference
